# Parse the old_songs.txt content into a list of (title, set of artist names) for matching.
old_songs_content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Remove leading "- " if present
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " to get title and artists
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs.append((title, set(artists)))
    else:
        # No artists? treat as just title
        old_songs.append((line.strip(), set()))
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for t, a in old_songs:
    print(t, a)
